Subject: POC next steps & risk tracker - Stellar Commerce

Hi Aisha - thanks for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery / kickoff:

Summary / success criteria:
- Verify integrated Redwood inference pipeline can serve requests with <= 250ms p95 for the retail recommendation flow (sample size: 1k requests/day)
- Validated output parity for top-10 recommendations vs current baseline (within business tolerance)
- No PII exfiltration and logs retained per your 90-day retention requirement

Proposed plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): deliver POC plan + environment details (attached: poc_plan_stellar_v1.xlsx)
- Week 1: infra setup and authentication (customer-managed VPC test subnet)
- Week 2: integration + initial load tests
- Week 3: quality eval and tuning; decision point for extension or rollout

Ownership / asks:
- Action: Aisha to confirm success criteria and provide test dataset sample (CSV) - due Wed 6/30
- Action: Marissa (me) to coordinate infra owners and share access details
- Action: Dylan to prepare tokenizer compatibility check and a quick sanity script

Risks / known unknowns (initial):
- Tokenization differences between Stellar's preprocessor and Redwood model tokenizer (could affect recommendation alignment)
- CISO request for additional logs/SOC2 evidence - may add procurement delay

Please confirm or flag anything I missed. If this looks good we can lock the timeline and schedule the integration call (I'll propose times).

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the clear plan. A couple of clarifications and an immediate blocker we hit on our side:

1) Tokenization mismatch: we ran a quick pass using our preprocessing and your model (small sample). The token counts differ significantly for product descriptions with SKU codes - seems like vocabulary handling is different and it's skewing ranking. Can your team share the tokenizer version / vocab or a normalization suggestion? (We cannot share full vocab, but a compatibility mapping would help.)

2) CISO asks: Tom (copied) requested logs demonstrating no plaintext PII in request traces and a pointer to your SOC2 report or an attestation. That may require our procurement/security to review before infra access.

3) Test data: attaching a 200-line sample (sent separately via SFTP). We'll aim to get the larger sample by Wednesday.

Quick answers: the success criteria look fine; timeline might slip by 3 business days if security needs additional review. We can live with that if there's a clear mitigation plan for the tokenizer issue.

Subject: RE: POC next steps & risk tracker - Stellar Commerce

Adding some technical context and a quick mitigation proposal for the tokenization mismatch Aisha reported.

Observations:
- Tokenization differences often come from two sources: whitespace/token normalization (e.g., handling of SKU patterns) and tokenizer vocab coverage for special tokens.
- For recommendation ranking, normalized token counts shifting can move top-k results.

Mitigation options (short term):
- Option A (fast): provide a small mapping/normalizer we can run on Stellar's inputs before sending to the model. I can produce a script that normalizes SKU/brand tokens (2-3 engineer-days).
- Option B (medium): run a custom tokenizer alignment pass on Redwood side for your sample dataset and adjust tokenization config (3-5 engineer-days).
- Option C (long): train a light adapter that compensates for tokenization deltas (out of scope for initial POC).

Recommended immediate action:
- I'll build Option A prototype and share a script + dockerized test by Thu 7/2. If that reduces divergence we proceed; if not, we escalate to Option B.

Also attaching the initial error bundle Aisha mentioned (error_log_tokenizer.zip) - includes token counts and example mismatches.

Please confirm owners: Dylan (prototype script) / Vivek (alloc engineer to help integration) / Rishi (security liaison for log evidence).

Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: error_log_tokenizer.zip
